title: Intel’s Foundry Pivot Deepens With Apple Talks And New U.S. Stake
text: Intel (NasdaqGS:INTC) is in discussions with Apple and Nvidia about using its U.S. foundry network for chip manufacturing and advanced packaging, as part of a broader supply chain diversification away from TSMC. The U.S. government has taken a direct ownership stake in Intel, marking an unusual level of federal involvement in a major semiconductor company. Both developments highlight Intel's push to expand its foundry business and reinforce its role in U.S. chip production policy. For you...
